metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.9 · 1989 · Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
metas.description: Two rock-'n-rolling teens, on the verge of failing their class, set out on a quest to make the ultimate school history report after being presented with a time machine.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.3 · 1991 · Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey
metas.description: A tyrant from the future creates evil android doubles of Bill and Ted and sends them back to eliminate the originals.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.9 · 2020 · Bill & Ted Face the Music
metas.description: Once told they'd save the universe during a time-traveling adventure, two would-be rockers from San Dimas, California find themselves as middle-aged dads still trying to crank out a hit song and fulfill their destiny.
